digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center's per-user rate limiter returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header, but the DC transport retries only connection faults so a 429 propagates as a hard failure.
The 429 retry must honour the Retry-After header plus up to 20% jitter and clamp the delay to MAX_BACKOFF_S, reusing the existing parser and constant rather than a second implementation.
Retry on 429 must be scoped to idempotent reads via a per-call rate_limit_retry flag defaulting to OFF, so mutations never retry and cannot reintroduce duplicate-issue writes.
The opt-in flag must reach the retry layer through two paths: _paged_search via _call_logged (PATH A) and get_comment_map's direct per-issue _with_connection_retry call (PATH B).
On cap exhaustion the adapter must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429 and never leak the vendor JIRAError past the boundary.
Retry-After must be read from exc.response.headers, not exc.headers, or every 429 silently degrades to no-header behaviour.
